segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמּוֹכֵר זֵיתָיו לְעֵצִים, וְעָשׂוּ פָּחוֹת מֵרְבִיעִית לַסְּאָה – הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ שֶׁל בַּעַל הַזֵּיתִים.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who sells his olive trees» to another so he can chop them down and use them «for» their «wood, and» before he chopped them down «they yielded» olives, if the olives are of a quality that could provide the value of «less than a quarter»-log of oil «per se’a» of olives, «these» olives are the property «of» the new «owner of the olive trees,» i.e., the buyer.

segments.he: עָשׂוּ רְבִיעִית לַסְּאָה, זֶה אוֹמֵר: ״זֵיתַי גִּדֵּלוּ״, וְזֶה אוֹמֵר: ״אַרְצִי גִּדֵּלָה״ – יַחְלוֹקוּ.
segments.en: If «they yielded» olives that could provide the value of «a quarter»-log or more of oil «per se’a» of olives, and «this» one, the buyer, «says: My olive trees yielded» the olives and so I have a right to them, «and that» one, the seller, «says:» The nourishment from «my land yielded» the olives and so I have a right to them, then «they divide» the olives between them.

segments.he: שָׁטַף נָהָר זֵיתָיו וּנְתָנָם לְתוֹךְ שְׂדֵה חֲבֵירוֹ, זֶה אוֹמֵר: ״זֵיתַי גִּדֵּלוּ״, וְזֶה אוֹמֵר: ״אַרְצִי גִּדֵּלָה״ – יַחְלוֹקוּ.
segments.en: In the event that «a river swept away one’s olive trees and deposited them in» the «field of another,» and they took root there and yielded olives, «this» one, i.e., the owner of the trees, «says: My olive trees yielded» the olives and so I have a right to them, «and that» one, i.e., the owner of the field, «says:» The nourishment from «my land yielded» the olives and so I have a right to them, then «they divide» the olives between them.

moves.summary: Below a quarter-log per se'a, the olives belong to the buyer.

positions.claim: under a quarter-log per se'a the olives go to the buyer; at a quarter-log they divide; river-swept trees' olives are divided
